figurative_meaning_en: an extremely small amount; a tiny bit
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাসে দাঁড়াবার মত একতিল জায়গা নেই।
আমি তাকে একতিলও বিশ্বাস করি না।
example_sentences_in_english: There isn't even a tiny bit of space to stand in the bus.
I don't trust him even a tiny bit.
note: The idiom draws from the tiny size of sesame seeds to emphasize minimal quantity in Bengali linguistic tradition.
